provenance.movement_reasoning: Meals cycle dishes through sink, rack, and cupboards; frequent washing and five put-away sessions reset them. Marie’s office kit returns through the dining and entry handoff zones, while Imani empties shift gear at the entry and protects her bedside sleep surface. Quiet reading, tablet, phone, and headphone use leaves a few small items at bedsides or living-room seating. Laundry, bathroom routines, food preparation, cleaning, and the occasional trips give the otherwise fixed household objects their movements; tidy-up restores their ordinary homes.
provenance.persona_reasoning: A two-adult household shaped by opposite fixed work schedules, with a compact but lived-in inventory that supports commuting, quiet handoffs, meal preparation, rest, and separate decompression habits.
